article.title_es: Angels Through Christ: despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Angers Through Christ: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Angels Through Christ es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, en la avenida Bedford. Abre los sábados por la tarde.
article.summary_en: Angels Through Christ is a food pantry in Brooklyn, on Bedford Avenue. It is open on Saturday afternoons.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está en 2263 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
La despensa funciona el primer, segundo y cuarto sábado del mes.
Puede llamar al (516) 807-2978 para preguntar qué alimentos ofrece.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 2263 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
It is open Saturdays from 1pm to 3pm.
The pantry runs on the 1st, 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month.
You can call (516) 807-2978 to ask what food is offered.
visit_tips_es: Vaya un sábado de 1pm a 3pm; recuerde que la despensa solo funciona el primer, segundo y cuarto sábado.
Llame antes al (516) 807-2978 para confirmar que está abierta.
La lista no dice qué alimentos da ni si pide algún requisito; pregunte por teléfono.
visit_tips_en: Go on a Saturday from 1pm to 3pm; remember the pantry runs only on the 1st, 2nd and 4th Saturday.
Call ahead at (516) 807-2978 to confirm it is open.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are any requirements; ask by phone.
